portInfo.description: Reine Ytre Havn is Visit Lofoten Cruise’s southwest Lofoten cruise quay: a single berth in relatively calm water used as a gateway to Moskenesøya scenery. The page states the quay is 70 m long, bollards about 140 m apart, depth up to 6.5 m, and that ships up to 175 m can dock — while the embedded port-facts module lists max vessel length 150 m. Treat LOA as unresolved between those two on-page figures until the harbour authority publishes a single table. Port master phones listed: +47 416 55 920 / +47 76 05 59 20; havn@vestvagoy.kommune. Door GPS null.
